input.summary: Add RevMed indemnity limbs for Third Party IP infringement, unauthorized access to Sanofi data and RevMed's breach of Applicable Law, and narrow Sanofi's Section 14.2 indemnity to Sanofi-provided content and Sanofi's breach of Applicable Law.
input.comment: [Playbook] RevMed's indemnity does not reach Third Party intellectual property claims and Section 13.5 disclaims any non-infringement warranty, so we have added limbs covering Third Party Claims that the RevMed Licensed Technology or our exercise of the licenses infringes or misappropriates Third Party intellectual property rights, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Sanofi data, and RevMed's breach of Applicable Law (mirroring Section 14.2), with the exception lead-in conformed. Consistent with our position that our own indemnity stays narrow, we have limited Section 14.2 to Sanofi-provided content and Sanofi's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.text: (d) any Third Party Claim alleging that the RevMed Licensed Technology, or Sanofi's exercise of the licenses granted to it under this Agreement, infringes or misappropriates the intellectual property rights of a Third Party; (e) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Sanofi's Confidential Information or other Sanofi data caused by RevMed; or (f) RevMed's breach of Applicable Law;

ops.oldText: (a) (i) the Research, Development or Manufacture of any Products by or on behalf of Sanofi or any of its Affiliates, Sublicensees or contractors (other than by RevMed or its Affiliates), or (ii) the Commercialization of Products by or on behalf of Sanofi; or
ops.newText: (a) any content, data or materials provided by Sanofi to RevMed under this Agreement; or

ops.oldText: (b) the negligence, recklessness or willful misconduct of any of the Sanofi Indemnitees; or
(c) the material breach of any of the warranties or representations made by Sanofi to RevMed under this Agreement or any Ancillary Agreement; or
(d) the material breach by Sanofi of any of its obligations pursuant to this Agreement or any Ancillary Agreement;
